name: s5_sybil_contamination
description: SYBIL CONTAMINATION: 35% of sensors are sybils duplicating a group's data (replication x3). Sybils inflate activity/quality counts but add ZERO information value, so their cohorts get no extra RMSE reduction. Activity/quality baselines overpay sybil-heavy cohorts; causal should not. Redundancy-waste metric is the headline.
